integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the chest up, one hand raised with the palm open beside the face. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A small dark mole beneath the eye begins to slide slowly out of its place, moving across the skin like a reflection gliding over glass, while the skin it leaves behind closes smooth and featureless. It travels steadily down along the jaw and the neck, a small living shape crossing the surface of the body in one continuous path. <Subject 1> holds very still, breathing carefully, and turns the raised hand to watch it arrive. In the final moment <Subject 1> raises the hand to the camera, and a small dark mole beneath the eye looks back from the palm of the right hand.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, restrained breathing, a soft sliding sound across the skin, and a small wet settling as the feature arrives.
